name: Barenton

attributes.attribute: home of the magical Fountain That Makes Rain
set within the forest of Broceliande

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Barenton is a Breton mythological site, also called Belenton or Baranton. It holds the magical Fountain That Makes Rain. The fountain carries rain-making power in the folklore of Brittany. MacKillop records the site under the spelling Baranton. He refers the reader to the forest of Broceliande. In Breton tradition, Barenton is set within that fabled wood.

okr.objective: Describe Barenton, the Breton site of the magic rain-making fountain.
key_results: Document Barenton as a Breton site.
